correctness.rationale: Every five-position equality pattern has a unique restricted-growth representative; the complete 52-case integer enumeration establishes weighted shadow sizes of at least 22 for equal prefixes and 30 for unequal prefixes. The 3-word ambient type counts total q(3q²+7q+12). Pairwise disjoint exact-two-deletion shadows of a literal systematic q²-message code contribute at least 22q+30q(q−1), a contradiction for q=2,...,6 because their excess equals q(q−1)(20−3q)>0. The executable checker exhausts all 52 patterns, all q^5 actual words for 2<=q<=7, and ambient counts. The symbolic argument establishes the quantified theorem; no finite trial is extrapolated.

The weighted integer shadow certificate rules out five entire alphabet sizes and exposes a reusable combinatorial packing mechanism.
